in_marathi.name: Kanwar
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Carrier of God's weapon
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kanwar हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। A name of God Krishna or Shiva, meaning 'Carrier of God's weapon'. The name Kanwar is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Kanaka' which means 'Golden', 'Rich' and 'Worthy'. In Hindu mythology, it is believed that God Krishna or Shiva carries a 'Kanwar' or a 'Krishak', a wooden pole or a trident, respectively.
